why: Git history confirms the finding. 855e330d (#532, closes #529, 2026-05-12) added a one-shot PreToolUse nudge for external MCP tools. 752d5236 (#593, 2026-05-16) replaced it with guidancePeriodic because the one-shot nudge was dropped by context compaction, letting large payloads flood context in MCP-heavy sessions (55 Jira calls, 24K to 75K tokens). DECISIONS-r3.md Q1 (line 7) says only 'Keeps v1 #529 (855e330d)' with no mention of 752d5236 or the periodic re-fire fix. Grep across DECISIONS-r3.md, the ADRs, and PRD-v2.md finds zero references to 752d5236 or 'periodic'. The doc as written points implementers at the pre-fix, flood-prone commit.
evidence: git show 855e330d --stat (cm-main): 'feat(hooks): route external MCP tools through PreToolUse (#532, closes #529)' using guidanceOnce. git show 752d5236 --stat: 'fix(routing): re-fire external-MCP nudge periodically, not once per session (#593)' — commit message: '#529 added a one-shot PreToolUse guidance ... In MCP-heavy sessions (#567 follow-up reports 55 Jira calls, context growing 24K -> 75K tokens) the single nudge is dropped by context compaction and later tool responses flood the conversation unchecked. Replace guidanceOnce(...) with guidancePeriodic ...'. DECISIONS-r3.md:7 text: 'Hints for those tools stay as PRD:103 says. Keeps v1 #529 (855e330d)'. grep -rn '752d5236|periodic' docs/v2/review/DECISIONS-r3.md docs/v2/adr/*.md PRD-v2.md returned no matches.
